title: DocIntent: Answerability-Guided Agentic Restoration for Real-World Document Visual Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2608.29037v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world degradations such as blur, shadow, distortion, and moire patterns severely impair the document question-answering capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Applying restoration tools before Visual Question Answering (VQA) is an intuitive solution. However, existing restoration approaches remain limited, as manually designing and executing restoration strategies is labor-intensive and requires domain expertise. Agentic restoration offers new possibilities for automation, yet existing frameworks primarily target natural images and pursue perceptual quality, overlooking that restoration should serve downstream tasks rather than optimize generic image quality metrics. To this end, we explore the value of agentic restoration for real-world degraded document VQA and propose DocIntent, a training-free Answerability-Guided Agentic Restoration framework. translated_title: DocIntent：面向真实世界文档视觉问答的可回答性引导智能体修复
translated_abstract: 真实世界中的退化现象，如模糊、阴影、扭曲和摩尔纹，会严重损害多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的文档问答能力。在视觉问答（VQA）之前应用修复工具是一种直观的解决方案。然而，现有的修复方法仍然有限，因为手动设计和执行修复策略非常耗费人力且需要领域专业知识。智能体修复为自动化提供了新的可能性，但现有框架主要针对自然图像并追求感知质量，忽视了修复应当服务于下游任务，而不是优化通用的图像质量指标。为此，我们探索了智能体修复在真实世界退化文档问答中的价值，并提出了DocIntent，一个无需训练的可回答性引导智能体修复框架。DocIntent首先评估问题的可回答性，然后识别……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了DocIntent，一个无需训练的可回答性引导智能体修复框架，通过评估问题可回答性来指导退化文档的修复，使修复服务于下游文档视觉问答任务，而非优化通用图像质量指标。
en_tdlr: DocIntent is a training-free answerability-guided agentic restoration framework that directs document restoration based on question answerability, serving downstream document VQA tasks rather than optimizing generic image quality metrics.
